about: Worker F exposure vs light-strength sweep at con_bright_hall (Nov 16): one clean launch per variant at y0_p0 (measured again at the end of each launch after one look round the room), testing whether Remix's ~2.7x lift over the original game comes from automatic exposure + local tonemapping defaults (rtx.tonemappingMode=1, rtx.autoExposure.enabled=True, evMinValue=-2.0, localtonemap.exposure=0.75, localtonemap.shadows=2.0). 01_base and 07_base_end measure run-to-run drift; exposure_vs_lights.py --score-sweep marks any variant whose effect does not beat |07_base_end - 01_base| as NOT_MEASURED.

variants.name: 03_ae_evmin_0p5
variants.about: raise auto-exposure floor from EV -2.0 (7.02x max gain) to EV +0.5 (1.24x max gain)

variants.name: 04_ltm_exp_0p25
variants.about: lower local tonemap linear exposure multiplier 3x (0.75 -> 0.25)

variants.name: 05_ltm_exp0p35_shad0
variants.about: lower local tonemap exposure (0.75 -> 0.35) and disable 4x shadow-branch boost (shadows 2.0 -> 0.0)

variants.name: 06_global_tm_evmin_0
variants.about: switch from Local tonemapper to Global ACES tonemapper with EV floor 0.0

variants.name: 07_base_end
variants.about: closing baseline launch to bound run-to-run drift against 01_base
